description: This Java class implements a gRPC service for managing edge device connections, sessions, synchronization, and event processing within the Thingsboard platform. It handles server startup, SSL configuration, session lifecycle, message processing, and cleanup of zombie sessions.

classes.name: EdgeGrpcService
classes.description: A gRPC service implementation managing edge device sessions, synchronization, and event processing within Thingsboard.

methods.name: onStartUp
methods.description: Initializes and starts the gRPC server, configures SSL if enabled, and schedules zombie session cleanup.

methods.name: setupSsl
methods.description: Configures SSL context for the gRPC server using PEM credentials.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Shuts down the server and scheduled executor services, and cancels scheduled tasks.

methods.name: handleMsgs
methods.description: Handles incoming gRPC stream of requests and returns a stream for responses.

methods.name: createEdgeGrpcSession
methods.description: Creates a new gRPC session, either Kafka-based or Postgres-based, for an output stream.

methods.name: onToEdgeSessionMsg
methods.description: Processes messages received from edge sessions, dispatching based on message type.

methods.name: updateEdge
methods.description: Updates the configuration of an existing edge session.

methods.name: deleteEdge
methods.description: Removes and cleans up a session for a specified edge.

methods.name: onEdgeEventUpdate
methods.description: Flags a session for processing new edge events.

methods.name: onEdgeHighPriorityEvent
methods.description: Adds a high-priority event to a session's queue and flags it for processing.

methods.name: updateSessionEventsFlag
methods.description: Sets the session's new events flag to true in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: onEdgeConnect
methods.description: Handles successful connection of an edge, replacing existing sessions, updating state, and scheduling event checks.

methods.name: startSyncProcess
methods.description: Initiates synchronization process for an edge, responding via cluster service.

methods.name: processSyncRequest
methods.description: Processes a synchronization request, either responding immediately if sync is active or scheduling a request.

methods.name: scheduleSyncRequestTimeout
methods.description: Schedules a timeout task for sync request processing.

methods.name: processSyncResponse
methods.description: Handles responses from sync requests, passing them to the appropriate consumer.

methods.name: scheduleEdgeEventsCheck
methods.description: Schedules periodic checks for edge events, handling migration and processing.

methods.name: processEdgeEventMigrationIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs migration of edge events if not already processed.

methods.name: cancelScheduleEdgeEventsCheck
methods.description: Cancels scheduled edge event checks for a specific edge.

methods.name: onEdgeDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection of an edge, cleaning up sessions and updating state.

methods.name: destroySession
methods.description: Destroys a session, adding it to zombie list if cleanup fails.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves telemetry or attribute data for an edge, either as timeseries or attributes.

methods.name: pushRuleEngineMessage
methods.description: Pushes an edge connection or disconnection event to the rule engine.

methods.name: cleanupZombieSessions
methods.description: Attempts to destroy zombie sessions periodically.

methods.name: getZombieSessions
methods.description: Filters and returns zombie sessions from a collection.

methods.name: tryToDestroyZombieSessions
methods.description: Attempts to destroy a list of zombie sessions.

methods.name: isKafkaSessionAndZombie
methods.description: Checks if a session is a zombie Kafka session.
